blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Joel Villanueva on Thursday condemned the mockery of persons with autism, saying such behavior has no place in society or in the digital space. “Who in their right mind would make a mockery of a person on the spectrum? Anong klaseng aliw ang nakukuha sa pagpapahiya sa isang taong hindi kayang ipaglaban ang kanyang sarili?” the senator said. (Who in their right mind would make a mockery of a person on the spectrum? What kind of entertainment does one get for humiliating a person who cannot stand up for oneself?) “Let me remind the hosts: hindi niyo […]...
